messages:
samir: Anyone seen the go-sdk reordering issue on streaming? Repro with our sample app: occasionally tokens arrive out of order after a reconnect.

olivia: Out of order how? example? :confused:

samir: Short trace: server sends chunks A, B, C. Client gets A, closes, reconnects and receives C then B. Happens with close+reconnect within ~30ms window.

raj: That usually means our reconnect logic pulls leftover buffered bytes plus new stream and we append instead of merging by event boundaries. Are you using the low-level event iterator or the high-level stream helper?

samir: low-level sse.Reader -> events loop. I'm using reader.ReadEvent() in a goroutine and a reconnect manager that swaps the reader when needed.

olivia: Could be a race where leftover partial event is appended to the start of the new incoming buffer but we don't flush incomplete tail first. do you have a minimal dump?

samir: Here's simplified raw lines we observed (timestamp elided):

```
data: {"tok":"A"}

data: {"tok":"B_part1"
```
(socket closed)
```
(data: {"tok":"B_part2"})

data: {"tok":"C"}
```

The client code treated `B_part1` + `B_part2` as separate events if the close happened between them, and when reconnect merged streams incorrectly order became C before assembled B.

raj: Hmm, the go-reader treats each recv chunk as a string and pushes events onto an internal queue. If reconnection re-enqueues leftover partial bytes at the front but another goroutine processes concurrently, order can invert. We should avoid two goroutines pushing to the same queue during swap.

olivia: Proposed fix: during reconnect, pause consumer, drain the existing socket until EOF and process leftover buffer into complete events, then atomically swap in new reader. Also add a monotonic sequence check in tests for event ordering.

samir: I whipped up a patch that serializes reconnect: stop reader loop -> finish drain/process leftover -> replace reader -> resume. Added unit test that simulates split segments and immediate reconnect. local tests pass.

ci-bot: PR #5011 opened by samir - fix(sdk-go): serialize reconnect to avoid event reordering; add split-segment ordering test

raj: Nice. Can you include a short note in sdk/README about using the high-level helper if you want auto-reconnect semantics (it serializes for you)?

samir: Added README blurb + example toggling auto-reconnect. Also added a small e2e in samples/streaming-reconnect that maps to our quickstart so QA can run it.

ci-bot: PR #5011 merged to main by raj - changelog: fix(sdk-go): prevent streaming event reorder on fast reconnects; docs + sample updated

olivia: Verified in staging with sample app. No reorder observed after ~200 reconnect cycles. thanks!
